source.title: 11 Things You Only Need To Buy Once (they will last forever)

tips.text: A waxed cotton or canvas jacket is a buy-for-life piece: hard-wearing, easy to repair and re-waxable when it loses its water resistance.
tips.why: Unlike plastic-coated jackets, it can be renewed and gains patina.

tips.text: Choose Goodyear-welted (or Blake-stitched) leather boots and shoes; they can be resoled instead of thrown away.
tips.why: A glued sole that fails ends the shoe.

tips.text: Good full-grain leather shoes mould to your feet over time and polish back up beautifully.
tips.why: Quality leather gets more comfortable with wear.

tips.text: Merino wool socks are worth paying more for: comfortable, temperature regulating and long-lasting.
Buy belts in single-piece full-grain leather; 'genuine leather' is often bonded scraps that split.
tips.why: Full-grain leather lasts and ages well.

tips.text: A mechanical watch in a timeless design, such as a field watch, outlasts a smartwatch; swap a fabric strap for steel to dress it up.
tips.why: It keeps working for decades with care.

tips.text: A full-grain leather duffel is a smart, durable travel bag that is easy to style.
tips.why: Good leather looks better with age.

outfits.outfit: jacket olive smart casual +waxed, sweater grey smart casual +wool, jeans navy casual, boots brown smart casual +leather, belt brown smart casual +leather, watch
outfits.why: Buy-for-life pieces: waxed jacket, welted leather boots, full-grain belt and a field watch.
